title: Super Paper Mario
shortDescription: Mario flips between 2D and 3D perspectives to stop Count Bleck from consuming all dimensions in the Void.
historicalSignificance: Acclaimed for ingenious perspective shifting puzzles and one of the deepest, most touching stories in Mario history.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
